name: Fril Signature Seal
licenseNotes: Draft — unreleased pending visual, technical, and rights review. The Fril Signature Emblem (calligraphic F monogram, crossed laurel branches, and four-point star) represents FrilLab brand identity and must not be designated CC0 without explicit brand owner approval. Generator script retains the repository MIT license.

sourcing.localSearch: Checked existing FrilAssets packages (assets/, materials/wax/, textures/) and sibling FrilStudio/FrilCraft assets read-only. materials/wax/champagne-wax is currently an unimplemented backlog item in docs/collections/wedding-stationery.md and no existing 3D wax seal package exists.
sourcing.externalEvaluation: Evaluated standard CC0 libraries (Poly Haven, ambientCG) per docs/asset-sourcing.md. Because the central Fril Signature Emblem is bespoke brand artwork and the 6-scallop pressed wax border + 256x256 OpenGL (+Y) micro-wax normal map are compact, deterministic procedural surfaces tailored to the 5,000-triangle / <500 KB web budget, authoring clean procedural geometry + packed micro-normal map avoids unnecessary third-party texture weight while guaranteeing exact brand fidelity.

provenance.license: Proprietary / FrilLab brand reference (kept local in ignored .work/, not redistributed)
provenance.notes: User-supplied Fril Signature Seal design board used to extract the flat 2D emblem, calibrate the 6-scallop melted-wax silhouette, and sample brand preset colors.

provenance.tool: Sub-pixel Marching Squares (4x Catmull-Rom supersampling) + Philip J. Schneider least-squares cubic Bezier fitting
provenance.notes: Canonical vector emblem containing 3 closed subpaths (261 cubic Bezier segments: calligraphic F, crossed laurel branches, four-point star).

provenance.tool: Blender 5.2.2 LTS (bpy / bmesh / mathutils) + NumPy + ImageMagick 7 (SVG rasterization + cwebp)
provenance.notes: Deterministically rasterizes source/emblem.svg in a temporary directory, builds the 3-tier SDF cushioned relief and 6-scallop pressed wax body, synthesizes and packs a 256x256 lossless linear OpenGL (+Y) tangent-space micro-wax normal map (seed 42026, 0.032 m UV repeat) in memory, exports model.glb, renders preview.webp, and saves model.blend.

runtimeFiles.notes: Self-contained glTF 2.0 binary with embedded 256x256 linear OpenGL (+Y) micro-wax normal map; zero external texture dependencies at runtime.
Optional lightweight PBR color/finish presets (Burgundy, Champagne Gold, Ivory, Dusty Rose, Sage Green, Forest Green, Midnight Black) applied at runtime without duplicating GLB geometry.

authoringDependencies.notes: Editable Blender 5.2 source with packed in-memory wax-micro-normal map and isolated Studio_Preview collection; zero external file dependencies.

distribution.localIgnoredWorkspace: .work/fril-signature-seal/ (holds diagnostic multi-angle renders, intermediate masks/maps, and reference board)

exportedGltf.z: +Z visible front face and embossed relief direction
exportedGltf.attachmentPlane: Local XY plane at Z = 0.000000 m
exportedGltf.originDescription: Exact center of the flat rear attachment surface for zero-offset placement on +Z-facing surfaces.

blenderToGltfConversion.blenderAxes: +X right, +Z vertical up, rear attachment surface on Y = 0, front relief along -Y
blenderToGltfConversion.exporterMapping: (X_glTF, Y_glTF, Z_glTF) = (+X_Blender, +Z_Blender, -Y_Blender) via standard glTF +Y-up export, preserving identity TRS on all exported nodes.

parts.name: Wax_Seal
parts.description: Root transform node centered on the rear attachment surface.

parts.name: Wax_Emblem
parts.notes: 3-tier sub-pixel SDF cushioned relief whose outer meniscus skirt embeds -0.022 mm into Wax_Body so the emblem never floats at grazing angles.

materials.customizationContract: Zero vertex colors and zero base-color textures; recolor independently via baseColorFactor, metallicFactor, and roughnessFactor on Sealing_Wax and Seal_Emblem. Planar XY UVs span 0.032 m x 0.032 m centered at (0.5, 0.5).
